title: Prices with company names
statementMd:
Show company name and closing price for all rows on 2024-03-04.

Expected columns: `company`, `close`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.company, p.close FROM prices p JOIN tickers t ON t.symbol = p.symbol WHERE p.trade_date = '2024-03-04';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
